_readme: Who to contact for each kind of report. Emails and numbers come from each body's official page (source), checked 2026-10-16. The app opens the person's own email app with these addresses filled in; nothing is sent by the app itself.

authorities.name: National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Centre (NDRRMC)
Land Drainage Authority
authorities.notes: Address published on the official site but on a non-government domain.

authorities.name: Road Development Authority
authorities.notes: Motorways and main roads. RDA points complaints to the Citizen Support Unit (csu.mu).

authorities.name: Mauritius Police Force – Information & Operations Room
Central Electricity Board (CEB)
authorities.notes: Faults and emergencies go to the 130 helpdesk (24/7). Email is for general enquiries.

authorities.name: Central Water Authority (CWA)
authorities.notes: Hotline 170 for urgent matters; leaks can also be reported in the Korek app.

authorities.name: Ministry of National Infrastructure (Landslide Management Unit)
authorities.notes: No email published for the Landslide Management Unit.
